SURVEY OF SCREW THREADS
( First Revision)
1 SCOPE
This standard lays down an overview of screw thread s used either for general purpo ses or in special appl ications. Threads complying with standards being given in Table I and those complying with International Standards in Table 2. In Table 3 types o f screw threads covered in National Standard s of UK. USA and Germany are given.

3 DESI�;NATION
The thread designation is generally to comprise the symbol denoting the type of thread and the value of the nominal diameter on nominal size. followed where required by the value of the pitch or number of threads, tolerance, number of start. taper and whether the thread is a left-hand thread. In the case of a number of screw threads conforming to this standard, the designation is preceded by the number.
It should be noted that when using Tables 1,2 and 3 only the latest edition of each standard referred to shall apply.
